## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] Release manifest verification (when packaging changes)
- [ ] New/changed MCP provider has provenance and security notes
- [ ] New research claims include scope, version, and evidence
- [ ] No proprietary binaries, credentials, or live targets are included

## Safety

If this changes execution, debugger, device, filesystem, or network behavior, explain the authorization and isolation assumptions.
